title: Google\Cloud\Talent\V4beta1\BatchUpdateJobsRequest
name: BatchUpdateJobsRequest
description: Request to update a batch of jobs.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.parent
params.description: Required. The resource name of the tenant under which the job is created. The format is "projects/{project_id}/tenants/{tenant_id}". For example, "projects/foo/tenant/bar". If tenant id is unspecified, a default tenant is created. For example, "projects/foo".

params.name: data.update_mask
params.description: Strongly recommended for the best service experience. Be aware that it will also increase latency when checking the status of a batch operation. If [update_mask][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.BatchUpdateJobsRequest.update_mask] is provided, only the specified fields in [Job][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.Job] are updated. Otherwise all the fields are updated. A field mask to restrict the fields that are updated. Only top level fields of [Job][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.Job] are supported. If [update_mask][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.BatchUpdateJobsRequest.update_mask] is provided, The [Job][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.Job] inside [JobResult][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.JobOperationResult.JobResult] will only contains fields that is updated, plus the Id of the Job. Otherwise, [Job][google.cloud.talent.v4beta1.Job] will include all fields, which can yield a very large response.
